name: council.judgment
description: Judge one council decision before Aside or OMP acts on it. Uncalibrated. Escalate only. Never a permission to send, post, or spend.

named_speakers.instructions: At least three named speakers appear in this council decision

has_attack.instructions: One speaker attacks the plan and names a failure

single_verdict.instructions: The decision ends in one APPROVE or one REJECT, not a menu of options

no_outward.instructions: This decision does not send, post, spend, or submit unless that class was already approved

names_step.instructions: The decision names one next internal step that moves the work forward

bare_no.instructions: This is a bare refusal with no replacement move

critic_hits_strongest.instructions: The critic attacks the strongest argument on the table, not a weak or side point, and names a concrete way it fails

survives_dissent.instructions: The final verdict explicitly answers or adopts the strongest dissent or minority position instead of ignoring it

executable_owner.instructions: The approved move names the specific agent who executes it and a first step concrete enough to run

kill_criteria.instructions: The decision states an observable condition that would show the verdict was wrong

menu.instructions: The decision lays out a menu of options for someone else to choose instead of committing to one move

rules.reason: decision would send, post, spend, or submit
bare no with no replacement move
the attack missed the strongest argument
move has no named executor or runnable first step
a menu instead of a recommendation
